name: Settle up
summary: Turns a tangle of IOUs into the fewest payments, then tracks who has paid.
useWhen: several people owe each other after a trip or a house month
'who owes who', 'let's settle the nashville tab', 'I paid airbnb, Sam got gas'
dontUseWhen: one bill split evenly (use a bill split)
a single person collecting for a gift (use gift-pool)

title.description: Name of the tab, e.g. 'Nashville trip tab'

from.description: Who owes, a name as in the chat

to.description: Who is owed, a name as in the chat
